title: 冬のスポーツ（シルエット）
subject_en: Solid single-colour silhouettes (deep navy) of people doing winter sports, each ONE figure with its equipment, readable pose, no inner detail, no face; cream-tinted outline-free shapes on the plain background Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: スキー・スケート・カーリングなど、冬のスポーツの動きをシルエットで描いた12点です。案内図やポスター、ウェブのアクセントに使えます。
items: a skier gliding downhill with poles
a snowboarder in mid-air doing a jump
a figure skater spinning with one leg lifted
a speed skater leaning into a curve
a curler sliding forward holding a stone and a brush
a ski jumper flying in a V-style posture
a child riding a sled down a slope
a child throwing a snowball with one arm raised
a hockey player skating with a stick
a hiker walking on snowshoes with trekking poles
a person pushing a large snowball to build a snowman
a cross-country skier striding with poles
